tagline: Songkran's water-fight clubbing weekend, Wonderfruit in the cool season, and a year-round late-night city.
summary: Bangkok's club calendar runs hottest in Thailand's cool dry season (Nov–Mar), with Songkran transforming Khao San and Sukhumvit into a citywide water-fight rave each April. Wonderfruit in nearby Pattaya anchors December, and weekly programming at Beam, Sing Sing Theater, and Mustache Bangkok runs late seven nights a week.
whenToBook: Book Wonderfruit weekend 8 weeks ahead; Songkran flights and stays should be locked 10-12 weeks out.
travelNotes: BKK and DMK serve the city; BTS and MRT run until midnight, then it's tuk-tuks and Grab. Pattaya (for Wonderfruit) is a 2-hour drive south.
peakHook: December stacks Wonderfruit weekend with cool-season club programming, while April peaks again with Songkran turning the entire city into a water-soaked open-air festival.

blueprints.title: Wonderfruit
blueprints.summary: Asia's most reference-grade boutique festival — four days of architecture-led stages, organic food villages, and an electronic lineup that pulls from Berlin, Tokyo, and London. Held at The Fields, Pattaya.

blueprints.title: Songkran Bangkok
blueprints.summary: Thailand's water-festival new year takes over Khao San Road, RCA, and Silom with three days of citywide street parties, club rave-ups, and headline DJ sets at Route 66 and S2O.

blueprints.title: Beam Saturday residencies
blueprints.summary: Beam's Sukhumvit basement runs a weekly Saturday techno program with regular international guests through Bangkok's cool-season clubbing window.
